resources.string: ClauDroide is an independent open-source project and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic, PBC. Claude is a registered trademark of Anthropic. ClauDroide provides official API access using your own keys (BYOK).
Start a new chat or open a local project to begin.
Select a project directory on your device to inspect and edit code.
ClauDroide banner: a green Android dome and a terminal-screen bot standing side by side and holding hands, beside the product name.
ClauDroide mark: a green robot with a glowing terracotta spark.
Enables ClauDroide to inspect screen structure and dispatch touch gestures to automate mobile workflows on your behalf.
